baseline.reason: The initial target builds failed because UBSan instrumented the 2011 build-time lemon parser generator, which overflowed while generating parse.c. I rebuilt lemon/mkkeywordhash without sanitizers while retaining ASan+UBSan on SQLite and the PoC. With the same harness and command, pre_intro exited 0 and reported that sqlite3ParseUri is absent; post_intro aborted with exit 134 and AddressSanitizer reported a heap-buffer-overflow in sqlite3ParseUri, showing a write immediately past a 32-byte alloca
